description.html: With 200 liters of volume, this aquarium (100x40x50 cm) gives you freedom in aquascaping: larger roots, more plants, bigger stones and more fish. Glass of the right thickness keeps it safe under higher water pressure.
The spacious dimensions allow ambitious aquascape projects with large roots, plant groups and rock formations. An external filter with sufficient flow is key to water quality at this volume.

We build custom aquariums: any dimensions, glass thickness matched to the volume, optional openings for filters and heaters. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for a consultation and a price. Delivery to all cities in Serbia.
